services.title: <this>This</this> is what I can build for you.

interface.title: Interface
interface.text: What people see and touch: web, mobile and desktop applications.
interface.link: Sends each request to Logic and shows the response.

logic.title: Logic
logic.text: Where the system decides: backend services, APIs, business rules, integrations and automation.
logic.link: Receives requests from Interface and reads or writes through Data.

data.title: Data
data.text: Where information lives: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, data storage, synchronization and information management.
data.link: Serves Logic and is kept safe by Infrastructure.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.text: Where everything runs: cloud environments, local servers, networking, deployment and security.
infrastructure.link: Supports and protects every layer above it.

system.title: The complete system
system.text: Four independent layers. Each does one job, and together they work as one product. The moving lights show data travelling between them.
system.link: Select a layer to see what it does and what it connects to.

me.title: <this>This</this> is Julio.
me.lead: I'm an independent developer based in Guatemala. I build software end to end and stay close to the business problem it has to solve.
me.text: Build it correctly, document the decisions, protect the system, and scale only when the business needs it.

final.title: Have something to build?
final.contactText: Tell me what you need and I'll reply personally.
